rationale: High-energy, command-center feel tailored for an athletic, sport-agnostic AI mocap platform. Emphasizes tactical minimalism and high-contrast metrics.

marketing_page.hero_layout: Asymmetrical split. Large typography on left, overlapping motion-capture image on right. Image must have max overlay opacity bg-black/40.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-headings uppercase tracking-wide px-8 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white font-headings uppercase tracking-wide px-8 py-3 rounded-none hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

cards.marketing: bg-surface_secondary p-8 rounded-none border border-white/10 relative overflow-hidden

data_visualization.traffic_light_status: Strict hierarchy: Green (#00FF88) for good/improvement, Amber (#FFAB00) for watch/plateau, Red (#FF3B30) for poor form/injury risk. Include 20x20px sparklines inline with metrics.

surfaces.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces.mocap_overlay: Tactical Grid overlay. Transparent background with neon accents.

motion_and_interactions.hover: High contrast shifts. Explicitly define hover text colors (e.g., hover:text-white). Buttons use scale transition (active:scale-[0.98]).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in and slide-up for dashboard widgets and marketing list items.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Use a kinetic texture marquee: Massive outline text (text-8xl+ font-black text-transparent stroke-white/10) running in the background for high-energy marketing sections.

hero_mocap.description: Athlete running in the dark - Use as main marketing hero background with black/40 overlay.

sport_basketball.description: Basketball player dribbling - Use in Sport Selection or Session History cards.

sport_sprinting.description: Silhouette of man jogging - Use for general athletic/performance tracking promo.

dashboard_abstract_grid.description: Abstract grid - Use as subtle 10% opacity background texture for AI analysis report section.

brand_logo.description: Minimalist tech logo - Use in header and footer as platform logo.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: 'Barlow Condensed' for headings, 'Manrope' for body.
Do NOT use the Shadcn Card component for marketing sections; use raw div/section with pure Tailwind for the Tetris Grid layout.
For the live webcam MediaPipe mocap view, position the video absolutely within a relative container, overlaid with an SVG or Canvas for the skeleton.
All interactive elements (buttons, sport selector, video upload, nav links) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sport-select-basketball').
Use Recharts for the form score progress charts, styled with the dark theme colors (#0A0A0A background, #00FF88 line/bars).
Do NOT use soft drop shadows (shadow-lg, shadow-xl). Rely on 1px solid strokes (border-white/10) and inner highlights (shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]).
Implement pure CSS or framer-motion kinetic marquee for the marketing page (e.g., repeating 'ANALYZE • PERFORM • DOMINATE').
